title_en: How to turn off Instagram's new Instants feature and retract photos you accidentally shared | TechCrunch
excerpt_en: While the Meta-owned social network billed Instants as a new format to share real-life moments as they’re happening, many users are looking for a way  to turn off the feature, especially those who have accidentally sent images to others, not fully understanding how the feature works.
